correctness.rationale: An all-integer, all-length proof factors every coefficient into two sine or two cosine terms and counts zero sets exactly via modular divisibility, including the sine intersection k=0. Even lengths are bounded by n/2+(q-1)/2 vanished modes with equality exactly on reflected sums, plus a pure-power-of-two exception for reflected differences; odd lengths bound all nonreflected signals and attain (n+d)/2 zeros precisely at reflected differences with maximal proper gcd. Exact checker passed 170640 cases n=2..80; independent original-DCT 90-digit checker passed 3542 cases n=2..22. Computations corroborate but do not replace the universal proof.
